name: Monk of the Four Winds
summary: An elemental mystic who strikes with primal energy, slows time, assumes a great spirit's aspect, and reincarnates after death.

features.name: Elemental Fist
features.summary: Gain Elemental Fist without meeting its prerequisites and increase its energy damage every 5 levels.

features.name: Slow Time
features.summary: Spend 6 ki as a swift action to take three restricted standard actions during the turn; movement does not provoke.

features.name: Aspect Master
features.summary: Permanently choose the Carp, Ki-Rin, Monkey, Oni, Owl, or Tiger spirit aspect.

features.name: Immortality
features.summary: Stop aging and spontaneously reincarnate 24 hours after death at a previously visited place within 20 miles.
